name: MBrickz Theme Maintenance Mode
author: MBrickz

sections.description:
MBrickz Theme Maintenance Mode is a lightweight maintenance mode plugin specifically designed for modern WordPress block themes.

Instead of requiring a separate design or predefined maintenance page templates, the plugin automatically integrates the global background colors and typography of your active block theme.

This allows your maintenance page to remain visually consistent with your website, without having to recreate your existing design or configure additional styling options.

Simply select an independent maintenance logo, create your message using the built-in WordPress editor, and enable maintenance mode.

The plugin is designed primarily for Full Site Editing (FSE) themes and supports compatible child themes.

Why MBrickz Theme Maintenance Mode?

  • Automatic integration of active block theme colors and typography.
  • No separate design configuration required.
  • No additional page builder required.
  • Independent maintenance logo selection.
  • Lightweight, standalone maintenance page.
  • No external services or third-party dependencies.
  • Native WordPress administration interface.

Theme compatibility

MBrickz Theme Maintenance Mode is designed for WordPress block themes that support Full Site Editing.

Recommended theme: Twenty Twenty-Five.

Classic WordPress themes may not provide all required global style information. Correct visual integration cannot be guaranteed with these themes.

Custom CSS and third-party theme modifications may also affect the appearance of the maintenance page.

Important limitations

Maintenance mode is not a security or access-control system.

The WordPress REST API and certain technical endpoints remain accessible.

Server-level caches, CDNs and third-party caching plugins may require additional configuration.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin directory to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the WordPress Plugins menu.
  3. Navigate to Appearance > Maintenance Mode.
  4. Select a maintenance logo.
  5. Enter your maintenance message.
  6. Enable maintenance mode.
  7. Save your changes.

Administrators with the manage_options capability can continue viewing the regular website.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin support classic WordPress themes?

The plugin is primarily designed for Full Site Editing block themes.

Classic themes may work, but correct integration of colors and typography cannot be guaranteed.

Which theme is recommended?

Twenty Twenty-Five is the recommended theme.

Can I use a different logo?

Yes. You can select an independent maintenance logo from the WordPress Media Library.

Can I format the maintenance message?

Yes. The plugin provides the WordPress visual editor for formatted text and links.

Can administrators access the website during maintenance?

Yes. Logged-in users with the manage_options capability can continue viewing the regular website.

Does the plugin work with WP Super Cache?

The plugin includes an integration that clears WP Super Cache when maintenance settings change.

Other caching systems may require additional configuration.

Does the plugin block the REST API?

No. The REST API and certain technical WordPress endpoints remain accessible.

What happens when the plugin is deleted?

The plugin removes its saved settings during uninstallation.

Images uploaded to the WordPress Media Library are not deleted.
